name: Grave Adder
title: Marrow-Coil Adder
biography: A short coil of ivory vertebrae rests among the larger serpent’s discarded armor. Red eyes brighten before a tail lash.
weakness: Its skull turns slowly through the tail-lash recovery.

skills.name: Grave Lash
skills.description: A broad tail lash covers the wedge in front of the coil.

review.combat: Implemented using shared family controller; complete individual fight not replayed.
review.phase: Not applicable: normal mob has no boss enrage.
